file_change.purpose: Own explicit repository/revision semantics used for exact Design reads, implementation-predecessor checks, mutation observation, and resulting revision identity.
implementation: Define Repository rooted at an explicit filesystem path and reject implicit authority from process current working directory.
Validate full Git revision identities and expose content-at-revision reads for Design Proposal resolution without replacing Markdown as semantic authority.
Expose exact HEAD, ancestry/descendant checks needed to distinguish implementation predecessor from later Planning-artifact-only commits, and clean/dirty working-state inspection.
Capture changed paths and operation classes relative to the declared implementation predecessor for Build mutation manifests.
Expose resulting candidate revision/state identity only as repository facts; Governance decides whether that state is accepted.
Raise typed errors when revisions are missing, ambiguous, inaccessible, or incompatible with the declared predecessor.

Classify commits between the declared implementation predecessor and the Build start state as authorized Planning-artifact-only descendants only when all changed paths are within explicitly governed Design/Planning artifact namespaces.
Reject a claimed Planning-artifact-only descendant when it includes implementation realization paths.
